content.text: What's New at FDU Valiant Knights! The No.15 seeded Knights were narrowly defeated by No. 2 seeded Iowa Hawkeyes in the first round of the NCAA Tournament, 58-48. The NEC champions finished the 2025-26 campaign with a record of 30-5 and undefeated in conference play. Congratulations to the Knights on a remarkable season! FDU Ranks #1 in New Jersey Fairleigh Dickinson University leads the state in CPA exam pass rates. Congratulations! Sean Jameson Named Vice President and CIO FDU welcomes Sean Jameson as Vice President and CIO. Previously CTO and CISO at Sarah Lawrence College, he brings expertise in digital transformation, cybersecurity and IT strategy. Go to What's New Seize the Moment! The FDU Knights shocked the nation on one of the world’s biggest stages. But that’s just the beginning.
